## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved.
- Package members: exact refined Skill, unchanged System amendment, retained common source boundaries, pilot resources and consumer interactions listed in this record subjects and the assessment scope below.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review, approved on the unchanged proposal subject.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r2, round 2.
- Material findings: no new findings; skl-dr-001 is resolved by its original reporter in the same recording batch.
- Correction targets: none remaining.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful primary batch persistence.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; return to route. This review makes authorized plan authoring eligible but does not initiate it.
- Claim limitations: exact Design package approval only; no implementation, completed pilot improvement, source retirement, adoption, final Verify, PR, publication or customer-installation approval.

## Independence and current applicability

The parent design author created and refined Skill, amended System and authored correction evidence; the user supplied direction/correction requirements. Independent agent /root/independent_design_review authored none of those contributions, made no engineering edits and owns both the original finding and this fresh assessment. Actual contributor separation remains intact.

Fresh primary context identifies the same accepted direction, the current refined Skill subject, the unchanged System subject, the stale round-1 review and its open finding. The reviewer reread the complete refined Skill, its source-qualified maps and the new design-contract-transfer-refinement.md. Full primary subject inspection binds 35 subjects; comparison with the 34 round-1 subjects shows only Skill changed, with the new refinement note added. All other 33 subjects, including Constitution, AGENTS, accepted proposal/review, System, source contracts/ADR/architecture, all pilot resources, inspected validators and follow-ups, are byte-identical.

Unchanged source inspections and scope judgments from round 1 remain applicable because this correction adds explicit preserved common conditions without altering proposal direction, System responsibilities, pilot methods, packaging mechanisms or validation execution policy. Reuse covers those inspected source facts, not approval of the old Skill or proof of implementation. Round 1 remains changes-requested with its old subjects and immutable finding origin; it is not retargeted or renewed. The current judgment is a new assessment of the revised package and its interactions.

## Eight-criterion package assessment

| Criterion | Judgment | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Realization supports required behavior, invariants and failures | pass | Existing conditional authoring/review references can receive complete v2 procedure after body classification. Body triggers, late reclassification, resource failure stops, profile/placement validation and archive comparison are explicitly preserved. The corrected lint rows now supply actionable enforcement outcomes. |
| 2. Technical, authority, compatibility and migration constraints | pass | Common transfer preserves original populations and explicit exceptions. New pilot improvements remain limited to proposal/proposal-review. Public-text lint excludes contributor sources; new/changed resource enforcement and inventory enforcement remain distinct without resetting completed audits. |
| 3. Feasibility does not silently narrow the approved goal | pass | Inspected recording-before-classification and dependent-reference weaknesses support a useful bounded improvement. Already-correct descriptions/assets remain baseline strengths; no token quota, third pilot or model-only substitution replaces the approved goal. |
| 4. System, ownership, recovery and external boundaries | pass | System's owner reference remains prospective until reviewed implementation and Verify. Workflow, Review and Closeout, Test, Record Format, CLI, distribution, installation and release retain their own decisions. Portable and adopted paths retain distinct authority and stop conditions. |
| 5. Important decisions retain identity and consequences | pass | SKL-DEC-01-05 retain the original choices and trade-offs, including raw-byte identity, explicit transformation, bounded lint, runtime fallback versus package validity and archive provenance. Old ADR judgments are preserved rather than rewritten. |
| 6. One current shared owner with reconciled consumers | pass | Skill now defines current presentation, portability, resource and enforcement rules directly; mapped specialist policy remains at named owners. Exact profile, placement, archive and source-preservation consumers have bounded required treatment. System references rather than overrides Skill. |
| 7. Credible basis and representative assessment outcomes | pass | Ordinary/governed/durable paths, complete/missing/untriggered resources, candidate parity, unchanged consumers and readable historical sources have distinct observation boundaries. Combined hazards require composed proof; structural success cannot establish usefulness or agent correctness. Delivery retains concrete proof allocation. |
| 8. Complete bounded migration and remaining work | pass | Retained tables and SKL-SR-01-15 now express the selected material common rules with populations and supersessions; mapped plan/method duties remain explicitly current elsewhere. Source retirement is conditional on complete disposition, original bytes and usable links; 17 remaining skills have bounded receiving families and next decisions. No additional material transfer gap was identified in the broader reassessment. |

## Reporter disposition of skl-dr-001

Resolved. The corrected retained-contract table defines R3i/j's exact canonical/public-copy coverage and contributor exclusions; R49b/d's recognized loading/prefix scope, arbitrary-path exclusions and fail-versus-explicitly-approved-temporary-debt outcome; and R53a/b's immediate new/changed enforcement plus inventory clean-audit or review-visible disposition condition. It distinguishes completed initial audit execution from surviving enforcement and prohibits resetting active enforcement or silently adding a new population. Legacy templates recognition is expressly lint recognition, not approval of a packaged class. The corresponding displacement rows point to those precise definitions.

Concrete application checks from the corrected prose: an internal contributor spec is outside public-skill portability lint; a legacy templates instruction is recognized for migration but not made a valid resource class; an unmapped dependency fails unless an explicit temporary exception records it as debt; a changed skill is subject to immediate enforcement; unchanged inventory is governed by its existing audit/disposition boundary without a newly inferred adoption. These cases can now be decided without reopening archived source definitions.

The broader transfer reassessment also considered metadata and description routing, normalized and approved-equivalent structure, role fields/summary/stage vocabulary, once-only vocabulary and table presentation, shared-versus-local policy, output assets/coverage, evidence selection/full-read escapes, projections/raw-byte transformations, safe fallback, specialist policy references and historical proof dispositions. The new portability and evidence rows preserve the same underlying rules. No new material deficiency or owner decision was found. This is bounded semantic preservation assessment, not universal inventory conformance.

## Selected sources and interactions

The full source identities remain listed in subjects. The retained review scope is the complete Skill/System package and their scoped source transfer: Skill Contract common numbered/unnumbered obligations with plan/method retention; Readability and Customer Portability rules with historical rollout; the whole resource-integrity ADR; mixed architecture resource flow items 1-10, Crosscutting resource-integrity section and corresponding building-block/decision boundaries. Proposal-family and later simplification sources remain specialist owners; adopted v2 recording supersedes retired storage procedures. The review includes all existing pilot resources and the actual profile validator, installed review-placement detection and supported archive profile comparison inspected in round 1. These unchanged consumer facts still support the planned relocation and required anti-bypass protection.

## Checks and evidence limits

Actually performed in this reassessment: read-only cat/sed source inspection; repository-local primary context with full selected activity/model/proposal/review/finding/blocker/applicability/evidence/decision fields; subject inspect --content full --max-bytes 8388608 for 35 exact subjects; mechanical comparison with round-1 subject identities; finding set --help; primary batch recording of this fresh review and reporter resolution. The recording request includes exact current subject reads and revision.

The author ran validate-boundary-first.py, validate-documentation-prose.py, validate-markdown-readability.py, local-link checks and git diff --check for this corrected subject; registered evidence and refinement note were inspected, including the stated structural-only and advisory-readability limitations. This reviewer did not rerun those scripts or execute package/implementation tests. Those executions are not a substitute for the semantic assessment above, and no implementation proof is claimed.
